name: pocketjs
description: PocketJS: create UI on every screen you love. JavaScript components drawn as native pixels on handhelds, desktops and embedded screens.
long_description: One bundle serves machines of different densities. An application states the hosts it is built for, its viewport and the features it turns on in the `app` section of its `pocket.host.config.ts`, and each host contract must present that viewport before compilation and packaging proceed.
